name: MyZubster Ecosystem
description: Public repository index used by the MyZubster ecosystem dashboard. Repository lifecycle states are curated from observable repository activity and project evidence, not inferred from repository existence alone.
generated_from: GitHub organization inventory and repository activity review

repository_policy.public_dashboard: Only public repositories are listed here.
repository_policy.lifecycle_status: Use ACTIVE, EXPERIMENTAL, MAINTENANCE, DEPRECATED, ARCHIVED, or UNCLASSIFIED.
repository_policy.classification_rule: ACTIVE requires recent observable development, maintenance, or runtime evidence. MAINTENANCE is used for integration/upstream codebases that are not a primary product. Empty or ambiguous repositories remain UNCLASSIFIED rather than being guessed.
repository_policy.production_note: Lifecycle status describes project activity, not production readiness.
